purpose: Native-only dataset engineering: select one A2 construction and one same-tense C frame before any further narrative carrier intervention, then require an untouched lexical half to license the complete A1/A2/P/C causal authority.
scientific_scope: Capability only. This receipt registers no L11H3, source-factor, carrier, or causal outcome.

prior_art_audit.finding: The latest claim is only site_live and requires staged native capability before any additional causal arms.
The first fresh carrier attempt was invalid because A1 past capability was .75; its post-last effective-value result is descriptive only.
served_one_purpose was selected and passed its A1/P construction holdout, but that license did not cover new A2/C prompts or new lexical material.
The 16-group new-lexicon causal attempt was invalid: A2 cells fell to .50-.75 and past C cells to 0-.50. No row or bar from it may be repaired after outcomes.
The fail-closed license binds one authority file, one logical authority digest, exact capability cells, and a reproducible passing native-only result.

authority.freshness: All 64 content nouns, complete prompt strings, and prompt token tuples are disjoint from the original narrative authority, the first fresh authority, and the failed new-lexicon authority. Cue words and the was/is answer vocabulary are intentionally shared.

selection_rule.fit_only: Open native logits only for groups 0:8. Evaluate fixed A1/P once and all three A2 and all three C candidates. No attention factors, causal hooks, or groups 8:16 may be opened.
selection_rule.fixed_family_gate: A1 and P must pass every registered FIT cell before any holdout is opened.
selection_rule.a2_eligibility: Every A2 direction-by-side FIT cell has 4 examples and must be 4/4 correct; .875 is the registered threshold, whose attainable passing value is 1.0.
selection_rule.c_eligibility: Every C tense-by-lexical-direction-by-side FIT cell has 2 examples and must be 2/2 correct; .875 is the registered threshold, whose attainable passing value is 1.0.
ranking: maximize the minimum registered-cell mean correct-answer-minus-foil margin
minimize the maximum registered-cell mean full-vocabulary correct-answer CE
selection_rule.joint_choice: Select A2 and C independently under the same frozen ranking, forming one of nine predeclared packages. Freeze both IDs and the matching package logical SHA before opening holdout.
selection_rule.failure: If A1/P or every candidate in either selected family is incapable, stop with a native capability failure. Do not open holdout, drop rows, combine templates by cell, or fall back after holdout.

holdout_rule.boundary: Groups 8:16 are lexically disjoint from FIT and no prompt in either half appeared in a prior narrative authority. Only the single frozen A2+C package is opened.
holdout_rule.cells: A1 and selected A2 each have four direction-by-side cells of 4 examples; P and selected C each have eight tense-by-lexical-direction-by-side cells of 2 examples.
holdout_rule.bar: Every one of the 24 HOLDOUT cells must have accuracy at least .875. At these counts that requires 4/4 for A1/A2 and 2/2 for P/C.
holdout_rule.failure: Any failed cell finalizes as failed and emits no license. No template fallback or row removal is permitted.

license_design.implementation: After FIT selects a package, construct one of the nine predeclared native_capability_license.CapabilityGate values. Its capability_id must include both selected template IDs; authority_path and file SHA are fixed here; authority_logical_sha256 is the predeclared selected-package digest below.
license_design.registered_package: The selected package contains 64 paired rows and 128 endpoint evidence records: A1/A2/P/C on all 16 groups. It has 48 phase-specific registered cells, 24 FIT and 24 HOLDOUT, all at minimum_accuracy .875 with exact expected counts.
license_design.selection_binding: native_capability_license_v1 has no selected-template field. Therefore generic selected cells are forbidden. The selected A2 and C IDs must be embedded in capability_id and causal_candidate_id, and the later compiler must independently recompute package_sha256 before finalizing or validating the license.
license_design.causal_preflight: A later causal experiment must bind the exact license SHA, selected package logical SHA, registered-cells SHA, and candidate-specific causal ID before queueing or loading a model.

interpretation_limits: The selected construction is capability-conditioned, so a later carrier result applies to that frozen capable construction rather than arbitrary narrative syntax.

A2 and C templates were frozen before their native outcomes, but their design was informed by the documented failures of the earlier relative A2 and yesterday/today C frames; this is lawful hypothesis generation, not independent confirmation of those old prompts.
Full-vocabulary CE and task margin are native capability diagnostics here, not simplicity or causal evidence.
The shared served/serves and was/is vocabulary prevents a claim of total lexical disjointness; only content nouns and complete prompts are disjoint.
The license utility does not verify that authority_logical_sha256 was recomputed from the authority file. The future compiler must perform that explicit check in addition to validate_gate.
